finding.title: Invalid HTML pattern weakens native validation on Wiki key fields
finding.capability: native client-side validation for category stable key and article content type
finding.backend_status: Laravel request validation enforces the intended grammar.
finding.frontend_status: Chromium historical evidence reports the HTML pattern as an invalid regular expression; identical literal remains on the frozen source.
finding.impact: Native invalid-input feedback can be disabled or unreliable and the administrator forms emit console errors; no backend validation bypass is proven.
finding.recommendation: Escape or reposition the hyphen and add a browser regression for patternMismatch and zero console errors.
